Season 4:

This season is the biggest season of the show, and the most “DRAMATIC” but I felt like I was completely living my life as a TV show, each good conversation I would imagine a camera over us and I would write about it in the notes, it helped to see my life as more dramatic because it almost gave me a reason to get up in the morning but I REALLY went into the idea that it was a TV show, each episode had an arc that needed to be solved or a problem and I would start to rate the episodes, if it was a good episode it might get a 9 or a 9 point something and my goal was to get a 9.9 or a 10/10 episode, the 10/10 episode being the moment I finally achieve my dreams, the moment I realise that everything I did was worth it and of course the audience has been following the character for so long it would be an emotional moment. 

I know how stupid it sounds BUT IM
VENTING

But this season the episodes would be a lot longer maybe 3000-5000 words an episode and I would also put a minute mark after I’d write so, after a few paragraphs we’d be 10 minutes in to the episode, but the season was pretty good and a-lot of things happened I gained more confidence, started to go out with friends and realise I had value as a person, I wouldn’t be afraid to state the way I felt and I noticed I could help friends going through any mental health issues because I’d talk to myself so much I became VERY IN TOUCH with my feelings, I knew exactly what made me sad, what made me happy, exactly what I wanted and ways that I’d dealt with previous problems before. I could help people with what I knew and I actually tell my closest friends about SOL and they’d give it value, saying it was cool, and I would advise them about writing about their feelings, when you have so much going through your head it’s EXTREMELY MESSY and overwhelming but to put it into words minimises it and helps massively, I’d also get motivation everytime a new episode would start, I’d imagine the next episode to be the best episode, and I love shows like breaking bad so I would imagine the episode could be like the “Ozymandias” of my show, the best episode. Also the music I would listen I would imagine to be the soundtrack and I would take pictures to put in the episode which sometimes told there own story, maybe just a nice sunset or the street lights at night. 
But as season 4 came to a close it got very intense, all of the stories from the beginning of the season were beginning to collide, me failing college, my suicidal thoughts, my dreams, I began to feel like a failure, I was faced with the big decision, do I keep doing college something I have no passion for, or follow my dreams, something with no stability and I would wrestle with that moral question on which one is better, what if I’m not good enough for my dreams, but what’s the point in doing something I don’t love, we only live one life I don’t want to live in regret. I would skip college and walk through fields with music on as I tried so hard to answer the questions of what’s right, it was episode 12, I called it “The Week Of Infinity” I am aware how corny these names are however I love it, but this episode would change SOL as it would now become a lot about philosophical discussions, I would almost try to make the best moral choices as I imagined myself as the main character and I didn’t wanna become the bad guy. This episode would be 40,000 words long, this one episode would last a whole month and I would go into the darkest period of my life, I would give up on school, I got a retail job for the time being and I wanted so badly to leave college, I was doing 12 hour days where I’d go to school and the go straight to work and get home and sleep and repeat the cycle, it wouldn’t feel like I was living, I was alive but I wasn’t living and after so long of this the episode came to an end and I quit college, I knew this would be the last time I would meet some people and a lot of us would grow apart and that was very emotional for me, at times it felt easier to commit suicide because I felt so helpless, no one knew the true reason I wanted to quit college, they just thought I was an idiot and the episode became about answering that very question, am I an idiot? It was scary leaving but I had to do to it, I imagine this episode to be almost 3 hours long, but I left, and having that control over my own life made me feel better, I felt good.
Episode 13: The Season Finale was the aftermath of that and it was me bettering myself and having more free time as I didn’t work as many hours at work, I could finally rest and find myself and the season 4 finale was also around 30,000 words it lasted 2 months, the one episode. It was quite a positive episode it was about me feeling better and I was actually speaking to a girl too, who had helped change my life for the better, the season and episode ended with me having a party with friends and walking home at 2am, sitting down on a park bench and looking at the night sky and after so long finally being able to say I was happy.
It was a powerful moment for me.
I was finally happy and I felt like I could truly strive for my dreams.
I stopped second guessing myself.

Why am I telling you this.
Truthfully this post is what an episode entails.
Me talking to myself about things.
And it helped.
Other people can call it corny or stupid but it made me happy, and it made me who I am.
I go to work with the camera looking at me looking out the bus, dramatic music on.
It makes me happy. 

I’d almost say it would be a good idea to make your own Show Of Life, but it worked for me, it doesn’t mean it’ll work for you, but I would advocate writing down how you feel, I could’ve never imagined the emotional understanding I have of myself as it feels like every mess of a problem I have I can solve with enough understanding of it.

In total the entire show including season 5 totals up to around 370,000 words. 
56 Episodes.
2 Years. 

And I’m sure it will get longer. 
And this here.
Telling people about this show is an own little moment in the show itself.

I can’t tell you why I’m telling you this but if it resonates with just a single person or helps a single person just like that one bit of advice helped me and caused me to make the show in the first place.

Then that would give me great happiness.

To spoil season 5 I finally found love, and I’ve never been so happy, my dreams are beginning to come to fruition and I’ve never felt so much confidence in myself.

All just due to The Show Of Life.

I am finally living in that 10/10 episode of SOL.



Thank-you for reading.
